page.summary: Choose the next useful generator from a real objective cue, then use a triggered resource read to leave safely instead of wandering for more information.

verdict.recommendation: Let routing information cut dead travel and avoid a bad generator commitment; the destination matters more than seeing every aura.
verdict.soloQ: Use your own generator cue when no one can call the next repair and reassess if Killer pressure makes that route unsafe.
verdict.coordinatedSwf: Compare the highlighted cluster with team assignments; communicate the useful destination instead of duplicating the same scouting trip.
verdict.mainWeakness: Players with current map knowledge gain less from extra routing slots, and a temporary resource read cannot make a spent route safe.

options.whyItsHere: Highlights the closest grouped trio of generators and rewards repair on those targets, turning objective search into a concrete destination.
After a generator completion and Killer approach, reveals nearby pallets and windows during its temporary window so you can route away from the next threatened objective.

opening: I04 asks where to work next. Read the grouped generators first; use the post-generator resource window only if the Killer actually approaches. The source has no verified four-slot build.

rows.situation: Déjà Vu highlights a grouped generator trio after you leave an objective or need a new work target.
rows.action: Choose a reachable highlighted generator that advances the match without crossing active danger; begin repair instead of searching for a theoretically perfect route.
rows.why: The cue reduces dead travel and dangerous generator choices; the highlighted group can update as the Trial changes.

rows.situation: A generator completion has armed Dark Sense and a nearby Killer triggers the aura window.
rows.action: Use the visible nearby pallets and windows to choose an exit from the threatened objective, then move before the window expires.
rows.why: The current Dark Sense resource view is conditional and temporary, not a standing map of all resources.

rows.situation: The selected generator becomes dangerous, finishes or no longer supports a useful route.
rows.action: Recheck the current objective cue, communicate the change if coordinated, and move to the next viable work target.
rows.why: Routing serves objective tempo; holding to a stale destination defeats the strategy.

rows.situation: You already know the safe work target or the team has assigned it.
rows.action: Work or cover a more urgent task instead of adding a scouting detour for the same information.
rows.why: The frozen counter note says routing information loses value when map knowledge already answers the question.

abortWhen: The highlighted objective is unsafe or completed and following it would waste travel.
The resource window has expired or its pallets and windows are already spent.

weaknesses: Known maps and clear team assignments reduce incremental information value; objective auras do not remove Killer pressure.
commonMistakes: Walking toward an outdated generator highlight after the objective state changes.
Treating Dark Sense as permanent resource vision rather than a triggered post-completion window.
